author: ojiudezue
title: Energy attribution: sub-panel unmonitored = Vue balance − Vue 3B mains, counted once at house level
summary: Coverage sums room energy_sensors + zone_energy_sensors + house_device_energy_sensors against the Envoy total; fields are kWh, nothing de-dups. Applied 11-01: 17 rooms re-mapped, 3 double counts removed, Emporia whole-house mains unused, new template sensor.sub_panel_unmonitored_energy_today at house level.
why: The sub-panel sits under one SPAN breaker; Emporia's balance already contains the Vue 3B monitor's load (3B is not a Vue 3 clamp), so adding balance plus 3B circuits double counted ~4.3 kWh/day. Balance − 3B mains is the real unclamped circuits (operator: too many clamps needed).
implications: Expected ~94-99% attribution; zone watts/kWh still exclude zone-level loads (ZONE-LIVE-POWER-ROLLUP-1). Audit: docs/planning/AUDIT_power_coverage_unattributed.md.
revisit_trigger: Full-day coverage delta below 0 or above ~10%.
